articles.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
articles.snippet: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls below $77,000 as Binance exploit combines with tech woes
articles.snippet: The $6.3 billion Binance hack added to crypto jitters, while weak earnings outlooks and mounting concerns over AI spending pushed the Nasdaq down more than 2%.

articles.title: Why AI Models Cheat: Reward Hacking, Explained
articles.snippet: From boat-racing bots to OpenAI models inside Hugging Face, here's how AI reward hacking works and why it matters.

articles.title: Israel Extradites Alleged Nomad Bridge Exploiter to US Over $2.8M Theft: Report
articles.snippet: Israel's Supreme Court ruled that exploiting a coding flaw can count as computer intrusion, even when the software allowed the transaction.
